chorus_he: כָּבוֹד לְךָ עֹז לְךָ · יָרוּם שִׁמְךָ עַל־הַכֹּל
review: Chorus is verse 2 (two lines), C repeats both joined by " · "; the Arabic label القرار stays as data. Glossary: הֲוָיָה for الوجود, עֹז for عزاً, נַעֲלֵיתָ for علوت. The repeated 1:1/1:4 refrain is kept identical like the Arabic; 2:1's parallel halves stay in one line in the verse and are joined by " · " only in C.
